semiconductor_relevance: High — DediProg specializes in high-precision test sockets and IC programming solutions, which are critical for semiconductor testing and validation.
summary: DediProg Technology Co., Ltd. is a leading provider of high-precision test sockets and IC programming solutions, focusing on enhancing testing efficiency and accuracy for various programmable devices. The company leverages advanced materials and mechanical engineering to deliver reliable and durable testing solutions for the semiconductor industry.
capabilities: High-precision test sockets for burn-in and final testing
Custom-designed Pogo Pins for low contact resistance
Self-developed PCR materials for enhanced socket performance
IC programming solutions for EEPROM, SPI Flash, and other devices
technical_expertise: Material science for custom socket materials
Electrical engineering for signal transmission optimization

regional_presence.Taiwan: DediProg was founded in Taiwan and has established a strong presence in the semiconductor market.
regional_presence.China: The company established a base in Shanghai in 2010 to cater to the growing market.
regional_presence.United States: DediProg extended its office to the US in 2016 to support its global operations.
